# LevelZero C++ ABI Wrapper - Complete C++23 Support

This wrapper was generated by the HFLabs C++ ABI Wrapper Generator v2.0, providing a complete C ABI interface to C++ library functionality with comprehensive C++23 standard library support.

## Generated Files

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| shim.h | C ABI header with function declarations |
| shim.cpp | C++ implementation with automatic conversions |
| Wrapper.cs | C# P/Invoke wrapper with memory management |
| CMakeLists.txt | Modern C++ build configuration |
| README_GENERATION.txt | This documentation |

## Build Instructions

### Quick Startmkdir build
cd build
cmake .. 
cmake --build . --config Release
### Platform-Specific Notes

**Windows:**
- Produces LevelZero.dll
- Requires Visual Studio 2019+ for best C++23 support
- MSVC 19.30+ recommended for full C++23 features

**Linux:**
- Produces libLevelZero.so
- Requires GCC 10+ or Clang 12+ for C++20/23 support
- Ubuntu 20.04+ or equivalent recommended

**macOS:**
- Produces libLevelZero.dylib
- Requires Xcode 13+ with Clang 15+ for C++23 support

## Usage Examples

### C# Integrationusing LevelZero.Interop;

// Basic usage
int result = LevelZeroNative.add_wrapper(10, 20);

// String handling (automatic memory management)
string text = LevelZeroNative.getString_wrapper_str();

// Object lifecycle
IntPtr calc = LevelZeroNative.Calculator_create();
try {
    int sum = LevelZeroNative.Calculator_add_wrapper(calc, 5, 3);
    string result = LevelZeroNative.Calculator_getResult_wrapper_str(calc);
}
finally {
    LevelZeroNative.Calculator_destroy(calc);
}
